Name: (AT) inkytea's Landlord Special
Author: inkspottedtea
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54804/54804-1793316426-1938526680.png[/img]
[line]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54804/54804-1793315265-62923955.png[/img][/center]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod adds [b]Alternative Textures [/b]recolors to the vanilla [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Heater]Heater [/url]craftable. I personally like to stick it inside my houses, but the default gray was ruining the aesthetic. So I took matters into my own hands!! I'm pretty pleased with the results :)[/color][/size]


[center][size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54804/54804-1793315292-529615735.png[/img][/b][/size][/center]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Please see basic mod installation instructions on the Wiki [b][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]HERE[/url][/b].[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]I do not use vortex, so I cannot advise to that method. All you really need to do is drag & drop the [AT] folder in my .zip into your Mods folder.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Once in game, you use the rainbow pail on the heater, & voila! You may bask in your old/new, gloriously neutral appliance![/color][/size]

[b][u]IMPORTANT:[/u][/b] You must have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] installed to use this mod!


[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54804/54804-1793316217-732093868.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[color=#D4D4D8]I've added a few (very basic) white recolors to the Heater! Options include (pics uploaded above):[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]off-white[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]cool white[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]warm white[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]... you know, the cheapest paints available at the hardware store ;)

I may add more white recolors to vanilla objects in the future -- just let me know if something else needs the [i]Landlord Special~[/i][/color]


[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54804/54804-1793316229-1066432501.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246][b]Alternative Textures[/b][/url] by PeacefulEnd (thank you!!!) [/color][/size][/*]
[/list][color=#d4d4d8]Make sure you have the latest version installed.[/color]

[center]
[i]Do let me know if you encounter any issues either in game or with the folder structure, and I will fix.[/i]
